security.safetyZoneDescription: Keep your account protected by regularly reviewing your security settings.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Add a second layer of security to your account with an authenticator app.

authenticator.title: Authenticator codes
authenticator.description: Use your preferred authenticator app to confirm access.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.description: Codes are generated on your device and do not rely on SMS.

disableConfirmation.title: Disable verification?
disableConfirmation.message: Disabling two-step verification will reduce your account's security.

reauth.title: Confirm your identity
reauth.enableDescription: Choose a method linked to your account to confirm your identity before setting up the authenticator.
reauth.disableDescription: Choose a method linked to your account to confirm your identity and disable this protection.
reauth.codeDescription: Now enter the current code from your authenticator app to finish disabling verification.

enrollment.title: Set up your authenticator
enrollment.description: Scan the QR code or use the key below.
enrollment.qrAccessibility: QR code for setting up two-step verification
enrollment.successDescription: Your account is now protected with an authenticator app.

feedback.multipleFactors: More than one authenticator is enrolled. Choose the one you want to disable.

recoveryCodes.title: Recovery codes
recoveryCodes.description: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each code can be used only once if you lose access to your authenticator app.
recoveryCodes.warningOneTime: You will not be able to view these codes again.
recoveryCodes.clipboardNotice: The codes were copied. Avoid leaving them on the clipboard longer than necessary.
recoveryCodes.confirmSaved: I saved my recovery codes somewhere safe.
recoveryCodes.leaveDescription: If you leave now, these codes cannot be shown again.

regenerate.confirmDescription: Generating new codes will invalidate all your previous recovery codes.

failure.enrollmentDescription: Your two-factor authentication is still active, but we could not generate your recovery codes. You can try again now or later in your security settings.
failure.regenerationDescription: Your previous recovery codes are still valid. Please try again.
